title: ProviderRunResult
description: One logical provider search outcome. The result owns generation; callers must not relabel a stale result by supplying a separate generation. Cross-field invariants requiring application validation: metrics.usable == len(ordered_usable_pool); metrics.displayed == len(canonical_session_results); canonical_session_results == ordered_usable_pool[:metrics.displayed]; SUCCESS requires usable >= 1; EMPTY requires usable == 0; ERROR requires empty pools, usable == 0, displayed == 0, and no fabricated geographic coverage.

coverage_status.description: COMPLETE or PARTIAL when geographic coverage was established. null means not applicable or unavailable. ERROR must not invent COMPLETE or PARTIAL.

failure.description: Sanitized failure copy for ERROR. Must not expose credentials, tokens, raw config, or stack traces.

candidate.description: Synthetic provider-neutral candidate example. Optional marketplace fields stay absent rather than fabricated.
